name: FLAC Player
author: user
description: Bit-perfect, gapless FLAC player driven by mpv — direct ALSA exclusive output or shared PipeWire output

barWidget.description: Now playing, transport, exclusive-mode switch and album library. Left = panel, middle = play/pause, right = next, scroll = previous/next.

schema.label: Exclusive mode (bit-perfect)
schema.description: Open the DAC directly through ALSA, bypassing PipeWire. PipeWire releases the device while playing; other apps fall back to another output.

schema.label: ALSA device (exclusive mode)
schema.description: mpv --audio-device value. Must be a hw: device for bit-perfect output.

schema.label: PipeWire device name
schema.description: device.name of the card PipeWire must release in exclusive mode (see pw-dump).

schema.label: PipeWire sink (shared mode)
schema.description: node.name of the sink used when exclusive mode is off. Empty = default sink.

schema.label: Show track title in the bar
